patch_description: Key parameters in the current approach: the soft-min/soft-max annealing ladder (T from 0.06 down to 0.0002), the seed library (D6 rings, icosahedron+poles, random spheres), and the two perturbation loops around the incumbent (perturbations of 0.02–0.13 and 0.004–0.019). The main opportunity per the analysis is a stronger mid-scale perturb-and-reanneal loop around the *incumbent best* — larger kicks (~0.05–0.15) with a full annealing ladder, which explores nearby basins more aggressively than the current small-kick polish loop. I add a dedicated 8-trial reanneal loop with growing perturbation scales (0.05 + 0.012*trial) and a slightly longer tau ladder, plus keep the low-temperature polish. To stay within the timeout, the seed sweep uses a shorter ladder and fewer maxfun. Expected gain: better escape from local basins around the D6-type optimum, pushing the ratio above 0.24.
